title: 3.13 She lives at eighteen Park Street
unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
lesson_title: She lives at eighteen Park Street
sub_lesson_title: She lives at eighteen Park Street
goal: Say where people live with at + a full address, on + a street and in + a house or an apartment (She lives at eighteen Park Street. / He lives on Park Street. / Ana lives in an apartment.), and talk about neighbors.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.13 Phone Number and Address: A1 answers What is your address? with It is 12 Park Street.; A1+ 3.13 says where people live. The one new grammar relationship is lives at + house number + street (She lives at eighteen Park Street.), taught against lives on + street alone (He lives on Park Street.) and A1+ 2.7's lives on + floor, with in + a house or an apartment; neighbor is the one new noun. The cast live on floors 6 to 9 of one building (A1+ 2.6-2.7), so Diego is Ana's neighbor, and its gym, store, restaurant, pool and office come back on their floors. Two new photos show neighbors at their front doors with the house number beside the door; house numbers stay at twenty or below. 2.12's write comes back with the address.
prerequisite: A1 3.13 address and Park Street; A1 1.9 Who's…?; A1+ 2.6-2.7 floors and lives on; A1+ 2.12 write; A1+ 3.11 's.
speaking_outcome: Say at quickly before the number (at EIGH-teen); stress the street name, not Street. Do not require native-like speed.
